verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented Fly.io feature for exporting account data, volumes, or databases in open formats. Fly.io's use of Docker images and standard Postgres suggests portable workloads, but that is adjacent rather than a documented export path. Community reports of having no way to get data off DB machines and no way to SFTP into a disk point against easy data egress, though with no vendor claim to contradict, the verdict is "none" rather than "disputed".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
